title: Starlink operations report normal status in Ukraine
excerpt: Starlink appears to function normally again in Ukraine following previous reports of access throttling ordered by Elon Musk.
body_html:
Starlink service in Ukraine appears to be operating normally again. This update follows previous reports indicating that Elon Musk had ordered SpaceX to throttle the country's access to the satellite network.

No further details regarding the duration or full impact of the throttling were provided in the initial reports.
